title: My profile
subtitle: What the council needs to know to book.
signIn: Sign in to see your profile.
birthDateHelp: Required to book: some facilities have a minimum age.
phoneHelp: So the council can warn you about a closure or a cancellation.
reminders: Email me a reminder before each booking
incompleteBody: Add your date of birth to be able to book.
birthDateRequired: Fill in your date of birth: it is required to book.

accountSettings.title: Sign-in account
accountSettings.help: The name, email and password you sign in with. Changing them here changes them everywhere in {{app}}.
accountSettings.name: Name
accountSettings.newEmailHelp: We’ll send a code to the new address. Until you enter it, the address shows as not verified.
accountSettings.codeHelp: Enter the code we emailed to {{email}}, or open the link in that email.
accountSettings.passwordSaved: Password changed. Use it the next time you sign in.

signInToVerify: Sign in to finish verifying your email. You will come back here and it will be verified.

privacy.title: Your data
privacy.help: Under the GDPR you can take a copy of everything {{app}} keeps about you, or delete your account.
privacy.exportHelp: Your profile, roles, bookings, the bookings you joined and your notices. JSON is for other apps; CSV opens in a spreadsheet.
privacy.deleteHelp: Deletes your sign-in account and your personal details for good. This cannot be undone.
privacy.deleteDialogBody: This cannot be undone. Download your data first if you want to keep a copy.
privacy.deleteUpcoming: Your upcoming bookings are cancelled and their invite links stop working.
privacy.deletePast: Past bookings stay in the council’s statistics, with nothing that identifies you.
privacy.deleteSignIn: Your sign-in account, profile, photo, roles and notices are deleted.
privacy.deletedBody: Your personal details are gone from {{app}}. You can create a new account whenever you like.

personalQr.alt: Your flash booking QR code. It changes every minute.
personalQr.private: The code changes every minute and works only once, so a screenshot will not work. Do not share it.
personalQr.brightness: If the reader does not pick it up, turn up the screen brightness.
personalQr.failed: Your QR could not be loaded. Check your connection.
personalQr.incomplete: Add your date of birth in your profile to book with your QR.

calendar.title: Calendar
calendar.help: Your bookings in your phone’s or computer’s calendar, kept up to date.
calendar.how: Add it with one button to Google Calendar, Outlook or Apple Calendar, or copy the address into Thunderbird or any app that reads iCalendar (.ics). It has your bookings and the ones you joined, and updates by itself when you book, change or cancel.
calendar.private: Anyone with this address sees your bookings. Do not share it.
calendar.googleSlow: Google Calendar can take up to a day to show changes.
calendar.resetHint: The current address stops working; you will have to subscribe again.

flash.help: At a facility with a free slot? Book it on the spot and check in whichever way the facility takes.

reader.help: Hold this QR up to the reader at the door: if the slot is free, it is booked and you are in.

code.help: We find the facility you are at with your phone’s location; then type the code at the door. It is checked and never stored.
code.none: You are not near any facility that takes bookings with its code.

door.help: Open the camera and point it at the QR printed on the door: if the slot is free, it is booked and you are in. First we ask for your location, which is checked and never stored.

staff.help: Ask at the desk or the staff to book the free slot for you: they can do it with your account or just your name. We find the facility you are at by your location to show you who to ask.
staff.none: You are not near any facility with contact people.

recommendations: Show “For you” on the home page
recommendationsHelp: Recommendations from your bookings and what is still free today. They are worked out live and nothing else is kept.
preferencesHelp: How the app speaks to you and what it shows or sends you. Saved apart from your personal data.
unverifiedBody: To book you need to confirm your email address: in your profile, ask for the code and type it in.
emailsHelp: Booking and reported issue notifications, including reminders. When disabled, notices remain in the app. Account security emails are unaffected.

rating.title: Your rating
rating.help: What the people you played public bookings with gave you, 1 to 5 stars. Nobody sees who gave which.
